// funclit: a func literal in argument position. The parameter types
// of func(w, r) come from mux.HandleFunc's handler signature; the
// body is capture-free, sees only its parameters and the bindings,
// and runs when the mux serves the recorded request.
mux := http.NewServeMux();
mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w, r) {
	w.WriteHeader(201);
	fmt.Fprint(w, "ok");
});
req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/health");
rec := httptest.NewRecorder();
mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req);
assert.Equal(tb, "201", fmt.Sprintf("%d", rec.Code));
assert.Equal(tb, "ok", rec.Body.String());
